purpose: Version-checking and update-transition protocol maintained alongside each published release.

version_ordering.rule: Compare corresponding version components from left to right as integers. At the first differing component, the larger integer is newer. Do not compare version strings alphabetically.

steps: Fetch latest.json over HTTPS and validate its schema and published status.
Compare the installed version with latest_version using numeric_components.
If release_status is not published, do not offer installation.
If versions are equal, do not update.
If the candidate is older, do not downgrade automatically.
If the candidate is newer, fetch releases/{latest_version}/release.json and verify its version and published status.
Download the full application package only after it has been published.
Verify package size and SHA-256 before applying it.
Apply only to the designated application installation directory.
Never overwrite, delete, move, or clean up %LOCALAPPDATA%/.digi/ or any other confirmed user-data location.
Keep a recoverable previous application installation and roll back if the update fails.

maintenance.rule: For each release, update current_planned_transition, latest.json, and that version's release.json. Do not mark a version published until the real full-package.zip is uploaded and verified.
maintenance.note: Only a full-package update is planned for the initial implementation. User data must remain outside the replaceable application files.
